title: poa apiculata
intro: Poa apiculata, commonly known as Poa apiculata, is a species of grass within the family Poaceae. This plant is traditionally used in the treatment of various health issues due to its reported health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Poa apiculata include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Poa apiculata include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
